docs.title: What is Textevo?
docs.text: Textevo is a text animation tool for After Effects. It breaks down a text animation letter by letter, word by word or line by line: animate once, and every letter, word or line follows with the delay you choose.

docs.title: How does it work?
docs.text:
When you click Add, Textevo puts two things on your text layer:

  • a Textevo effect, which gathers all the controls: strength, delay, direction, position, scale, rotation, opacity, blur...
  • a text animator, linked to the effect by expressions, which does the work on the text.

You animate the Strength of the effect: at 100 % the text is fully transformed (moved, scaled, transparent...), at 0 % it is back to normal. Each letter, word or line plays this animation with the delay you have set.

You can stack as many Textevo as you want on the same text layer: one for the arrival, one for the exit, one for an animation in between...

New to Textevo?

Follow Getting started to make your first animation in a few minutes.

docs.title: What's new in Textevo 2026 (beta)
docs.text:
Fx: Elastic, Bounce and Oscillation The new Fx button adds an elastic, a bounce or an oscillation to the strength of a Textevo, with its own controls in the effect. Textevo can optimize your keyframes so the effect really shows. Presets that land where you expect Presets are applied from the start of the text layer (or at the current time with Alt + click), on all the selected text layers or on a new one. The presets window has a search field and a rename button. Your old presets are updated automatically. Presets that keep your whole look The selectors and properties you add to the Textevo text animator (wiggly selector, fill color...) are saved in the presets and kept when you copy, switch 2D / 3D or change the Fx. Presets can also save the other effects of the layer (drop shadow, glow...). And also Alt + click on Add for the reversed animation with mirrored easing, Alt + click on Paste to paste at the current time, a new settings window, dialogs in the After Effects colors and many fixes.

See the version history for all the changes.

docs.title: About
docs.text:
Textevo is made by Wlazinski Matthieu, with the help of the community of motion-cafe.com.

Textevo is available on aescripts + aeplugins. For help, bug reports or ideas, open a support ticket from the product page.

docs.title: Controls
docs.text: All the controls of a Textevo are in its effect:

docs.title: Strength
docs.text:
The intensity of the Textevo, the parameter you animate.

  • 100 %: the text gets all the Transform and Style values of the effect.
  • 0 %: the text is back to normal.

Each letter, word or line plays the Strength animation with its own delay.

You can add expressions on the Strength (wiggle, loopOut...) or use your favorite easing scripts. For an elastic, a bounce or an oscillation, use the Fx button: it follows the delay of each letter.

docs.title: Delay
docs.text:
The time between two letters, words or lines, in frames.

With a delay of 2, the second letter starts 2 frames after the first one, the third one 4 frames after... Negative values are possible.

docs.title: Direction
docs.text:
The order in which the letters, words or lines play the animation:

Direction Order Reading direction from the first to the last Reversed from the last to the first Outward from the center to the edges Inward from the edges to the center Random in a random order, changed with the Random Seed From index from the letter, word or line set with From index, towards both edges

docs.title: From index
docs.text: With the From index direction: the letter, word or line where the animation starts.

docs.title: Random Seed
docs.text: With the Random direction: change it to get another random order.

docs.title: Transform
docs.text:
What the text gets at 100 % of strength, relatively to its normal state:

  • Anchor Point, Position (X, Y, Z): offsets in pixels
  • Scale (or X, Y, Z with Separate XYZ)
  • Skew (angle and axis)
  • Rotation (and X, Y, Z rotations when the layer is in 3D per character)
  • Opacity

Example

With a Position Y of 100 and a strength of 50 %, the text is moved by 50 px on Y.

docs.title: Style
docs.text: Works like Transform, with: Stroke Width, Line Anchor, Tracking Amount, Line Spacing, Character Offset, Character Replace and Blur.

docs.title: Fx controls
docs.text: A Textevo with an Fx has an extra group at the end of its effect: Elastic, Bounce or Oscillation, with its own controls.

docs.title: My preset lands far after my text layer, sometimes out of the composition
docs.text: This was a bug of the presets saved before Textevo 2026: they stored their keyframes from the start of the composition they were saved in. Update Textevo, open the presets window and accept to update your old presets: see Presets saved with an older version.

docs.title: My elastic or bounce doesn't show
docs.text: The Elastic and the Bounce start from the speed of the Strength when it reaches a keyframe: a keyframe eased on arrival arrives with a speed of 0, and nothing happens after it. Let Textevo optimize the keyframes, or make them arrive linear: see Eased keyframes.

docs.title: Why use the Remove and Rename buttons?
docs.text:
A Textevo is made of an effect and a text animator linked by expressions. After Effects doesn't tell scripts when you delete or rename an effect by hand, so Textevo cannot fix things afterwards:

  • deleting the effect by hand leaves its text animator on the layer, with expression errors: delete it by hand too, or better, use the Remove button;
  • renaming the effect by hand updates the expressions but not the name of the text animator: use the Rename button to keep both names in sync.

docs.title: Why isn't "Based on" in the effect?
docs.text: This option can't be controlled by expressions, that's why it is a button of the panel.

docs.title: Why isn't there a fill color in the effect?
docs.text:
It would override the color of your text even at 0 % of strength. But you can add a Fill Color (or a stroke...) to the Textevo text animator yourself, with the Add menu of the animator: it follows the strength like the other properties.

What you add to the text animator is kept when you copy the Textevo, save it as a preset, switch 2D / 3D or change its Fx.

docs.title: Can a preset save a drop shadow, a glow or my own selectors?
docs.text: Yes. What you add to the Textevo text animator (a wiggly selector, a fill color...) is always saved. The other effects of the layer (drop shadow, glow, blur...) are saved when you save the whole layer and choose Save all: see Save a preset.

docs.title: Can I apply a preset on several layers?
docs.text: Yes: select all the text layers, then apply the preset. With no text layer selected, Textevo creates one.

docs.title: How do I share my presets?
docs.text: A preset is a .json file in the presets folder of Textevo (see Where are the presets?). Send the file: the other person copies it in their presets folder and clicks refresh in the presets window.

docs.title: After Effects asks to allow scripts to write files
docs.text: Textevo saves its settings and presets on your computer: check "Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network" in the preferences. See Installation.

docs.title: Fx
docs.text:
The Fx button adds an Elastic, a Bounce or an Oscillation to the strength of a Textevo.

Select one or more Textevo effects (or text layers, for all their Textevo), click Fx and choose:

Fx What it does Controls None back to the standard Textevo Elastic overshoots and wobbles after each keyframe Amplitude, Frequency, Decay Bounce bounces back after each keyframe Elasticity, Gravity, Max bounces Oscillation a continuous sine wave on the strength Amplitude, Frequency, Phase per character

The Fx controls are in a new group at the end of the effect: tweak and keyframe them like any other parameter.

The Fx follows the delay of each letter, word or line, like the rest of the animation. The effect keeps its name, its position, its keyframes and its "Based on" mode, and the Fx is saved in the copies and the presets.

docs.title: Elastic
docs.text:
After each keyframe of the Strength, the text goes past its value and wobbles back to it.

  • Amplitude: how far it goes past the value.
  • Frequency: the number of wobbles per second.
  • Decay: how fast the wobbles fade out.

docs.title: Bounce
docs.text:
After each keyframe of the Strength, the text bounces back, like a ball on the floor.

  • Elasticity: the height of each bounce compared to the previous one.
  • Gravity: higher values give faster, smaller bounces.
  • Max bounces: the number of bounces.

docs.title: Oscillation
docs.text:
A continuous sine wave added to the strength, even without keyframes: floating texts, pulses...

  • Amplitude: the size of the oscillation, in % of strength.
  • Frequency: the number of oscillations per second.
  • Phase per character: offsets each letter, word or line, for a wave through the text.

docs.title: Eased keyframes
docs.text:
The Elastic and the Bounce start from the speed of the Strength when it reaches a keyframe. A keyframe eased on arrival (Easy Ease, or the "Second key" influence of the settings) arrives with a speed of 0: nothing happens after it.

When you choose Elastic or Bounce, or paste or apply a preset using them, Textevo detects these keyframes and asks what to do:

  • Optimized keys: linear arrival, and a slow departure from the previous keyframe (at least 75 % of influence): the speed builds up and the keyframe is reached fast. The strongest effect.
  • Linear arrival: only removes the ease on arrival.
  • Keep the keys: changes nothing.

Check Don't ask again to always do the same thing. The choice can be changed in the settings: "Elastic / bounce on eased keys".

Tip

Keyframes closer to each other also give a stronger elastic or bounce: the arrival is faster.

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text: Your first Textevo animation: letters that rise and fade in, one after the other.

docs.title: 1. Add a Textevo
docs.text:
Select a text layer (or nothing: Textevo creates a text layer for you) and click Add in the Textevo panel.

Textevo adds:

  • a TextEvo effect on the layer, with all the controls,
  • two keyframes on its Strength: 100 % at the current time, 0 % one second later.

Info

The duration, the influence of the keyframes, the delay and the direction of a new Textevo are set in the settings.

docs.title: 2. Choose what moves
docs.text:
Open the TextEvo effect in the Effect Controls. By default the Transform values change nothing: set what the letters do at 100 % of strength, for example:

  • Transform > Position > Y: 80 (the letters come from 80 px lower)
  • Transform > Opacity: 0 (the letters are transparent at the start)

Play the animation: at 100 % the letters are moved down and transparent, at 0 % they are at their normal place. Each letter plays it a little after the previous one.

docs.title: 3. Adjust the rhythm
docs.text:
• Delay: the number of frames between two letters. Increase it for a slower cascade.
  • Direction: reading direction, reversed, from the center (outward), towards the center (inward), random or from a given index.
  • Move the Strength keyframes and change their easing like any keyframes, in the timeline or the graph editor.

docs.title: 4. Letters, words or lines
docs.text:
Click Based on in the panel to animate the text letter by letter, letter by letter without the spaces, word by word or line by line.

With "Auto adapt the delay" checked, the delay is adjusted to keep about the same total duration.

docs.title: 5. Animate the exit
docs.text:
Hold Alt and click Add: this adds a second Textevo with reversed keyframes (0 % then 100 %), to make the text leave. Set its Transform values (for example Position Y -80 and Opacity 0) and move its keyframes to the end of the layer.

You can stack as many Textevo as you want on the same layer.

docs.title: 6. Go further
docs.text:
• Add an elastic, a bounce or an oscillation with the Fx button.
  • Save your animation as a preset to reuse it on any text in one click.
  • Add your own selectors or properties to the Textevo text animator (a wiggly selector, a fill color...): they are kept in the copies and presets.

docs.title: 1. Allow scripts to write files
docs.text:
Textevo saves its settings and presets on your computer, After Effects has to allow it:

  • After Effects 2020 and later: Edit > Preferences > Scripting & Expressions
  • Older versions: Edit > Preferences > General

and check Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network.

On macOS, the Preferences are in the After Effects menu.

docs.title: 2. Install the panel
docs.text:
In After Effects: File > Scripts > Install ScriptUI Panel... and select Textevo.jsx.

Or copy Textevo.jsx to the ScriptUI Panels folder of After Effects:

WindowsmacOS 
C:\Program Files\Adobe\Adobe After Effects <version>\Support Files\Scripts\ScriptUI Panels\

/Applications/Adobe After Effects <version>/Scripts/ScriptUI Panels/

docs.title: 3. Restart After Effects
docs.text: Open the panel from the Window menu > Textevo.jsx, and dock it where you like: the panel adapts to a vertical or horizontal layout.

docs.title: First launch
docs.text: Textevo asks for a folder where it saves its settings and presets. If you cancel, your Documents folder is used. You can change it later in the settings.

docs.title: Updating from an older version
docs.text:
• Install Textevo.jsx as above. If the older version was named differently (textevo.jsx, textEvo241118.jsx...), remove it from the ScriptUI Panels folder, or you will have two Textevo panels in the Window menu.
  • Your settings are kept.
  • Your presets are kept too. The first time you open the presets window, Textevo offers to update the presets saved with an older version: see Presets saved with an older version.
  • The Textevo already in your projects keep working.

docs.title: Interface
docs.text:
The Textevo panel adapts to its size: dock it vertically or horizontally.

From left to right (or from top to bottom): Add, Remove, Rename, Based on, 2D / 3D, Fx, Copy, Paste, Presets and Settings. Hover a button to see what it does.

Most buttons work on the selected Textevo effects, or on all the Textevo of the selected text layers when no Textevo is selected.

Always use the Remove and Rename buttons

A Textevo is made of two parts: the Textevo effect and a text animator on the text layer, linked by expressions. Removing or renaming the effect by hand only changes one of the two parts. Use the Remove and Rename buttons of the panel, which handle both.

docs.title: Add
docs.text:
Adds a Textevo to the selected text layer. If no text layer is selected, Textevo creates one in the active composition.

  • Click: keyframes on the Strength from 100 % to 0 %, starting at the current time (an arrival).
  • Alt + click: the reversed animation, from 0 % to 100 %, with mirrored easing (an exit).

The keyframes, their easing, the delay and the direction of a new Textevo are set in the settings.

docs.title: Remove
docs.text:
Removes the selected Textevo, or all the Textevo of the selected layers: the effect and its text animator.

If you delete the effect by hand, its text animator stays on the layer with expression errors, and has to be deleted by hand too.

docs.title: Rename
docs.text:
Renames the selected Textevo effect and its text animator together.

If you rename the effect by hand, After Effects updates the expressions but not the name of the text animator: the effect and its animator no longer have the same name in the timeline.

docs.title: Based on
docs.text:
Chooses how the text is broken down: Letters, Letters spaceless, Words or Lines.

Auto adapt the delay: adjusts the delay to the new number of letters, words or lines, to keep about the same total duration. For example, switching from 12 letters to 3 words multiplies the delay by 4.

docs.title: 2D / 3D
docs.text: Switches the 3D per character of the layer on or off. The Textevo animators are rebuilt with the 2D or 3D properties (3D rotations, Z position...), keeping your settings and what you added to them.

docs.title: Fx
docs.text: Adds an Elastic, a Bounce or an Oscillation to the strength of the Textevo. See Fx.

docs.title: Copy
docs.text: Copies the selected Textevo, or all the Textevo of the layer: the effects with their keyframes, their Fx, their "Based on" mode and what you added to their text animators.

docs.title: Paste
docs.text:
Pastes the copied Textevo on all the selected text layers.

  • Click: the keyframes keep their position from the start (in point) of the layer: a keyframe on the first frame of the copied layer lands on the first frame of the target layer.
  • Alt + click: the first keyframe lands at the current time.

docs.title: Presets
docs.text:
• Click: opens the presets window.
  • Shift + click: saves the Textevo of the selected layer as a preset.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text: Opens the settings: the default values of a new Textevo, the presets folder...

docs.title: Presets
docs.text:
Save your Textevo animations and apply them on any text in one click.

Open the presets window with the Presets button of the panel.

docs.title: Save a preset
docs.text:
Select a text layer with Textevo, then click add in the presets window, or Shift + click the Presets button of the panel. Give your preset a name.

  • If you selected some Textevo effects, only those are saved.
  • If you selected the whole layer and it has other effects (drop shadow, glow, blur...), Textevo lists them and asks what to save, in the same window as the name:
    • Save all: the Textevo and the other effects of the layer.
    • Textevo only: only the Textevo.
    • Cancel: nothing is saved.

docs.title: What a preset contains
docs.text:
• The Textevo effects, with their values, keyframes and expressions, and their Fx.
  • Their "Based on" mode and the 3D per character of the layer.
  • What you added to the Textevo text animators: other selectors (wiggly, range, expression...) and properties (fill color, stroke...), with their values, keyframes and expressions.
  • With Save all: the other effects of the layer, in their order, enabled or not.

The keyframes are saved from the start (in point) of the layer.

docs.title: Apply a preset
docs.text:
Select one or more presets and click apply, or double click a preset.

  • The presets are applied on all the selected text layers.
  • If no text layer is selected, Textevo creates one in the active composition, like the Add button.
  • The keyframes start from the start (in point) of each layer.
  • Alt + click on apply (or Alt + double click): the first keyframe lands at the current time.

Effects that are not installed

If a preset contains effects that are not installed on your computer (third party effects), they are skipped and Textevo lists them.

Effects that point to other layers

Effect parameters that point to another layer (a displacement map, a source layer...) are not saved: they have no meaning in another composition.

docs.title: Search, rename, remove
docs.text:
• Search: type a part of a name to filter the list (not case sensitive). The presets are sorted by name.
  • rename: renames the selected preset (one at a time).
  • remove: deletes the selected presets, after a confirmation.
  • refresh: reloads the list, for example after copying preset files in the folder.

docs.title: Where are the presets?
docs.text: In the presets folder of the Textevo folder chosen at the first launch (see the settings). A preset is a .json file: copy it to share it, or to use it on another computer.

docs.title: Presets saved with an older version
docs.text:
The presets saved before Textevo 2026 stored their keyframes from the start of the composition they were saved in: once applied, they could land far after the text layer, sometimes outside of the composition.

When the presets window opens, Textevo detects them and offers to update them, so that they start at the start of the layer. A copy of the original files is kept in the backup_before_2026 folder of your presets.

If you don't update them, you can still apply them with Alt + click: the first keyframe lands at the current time.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
Click the Settings button of the panel.

Change the values, then click Save. Cancel closes the window without saving, Reset puts back the default values (saved when you click Save).

docs.title: Add button
docs.text:
The values used when you click Add.

Add keyframes on Strength Adds two keyframes on the strength of the new Textevo: from 100 % to 0 %, or from 0 % to 100 % with Alt + click on Add. Unchecked, the Textevo is added without keyframes. Duration (seconds) The time between the two keyframes. Keyframe influence (%) The easing of the two keyframes: the In and Out influence of the First key and of the Second key, from 0 (linear) to 100. With Alt + click on Add, the easing is mirrored. Delay (frames between characters) The delay of the new Textevo. Direction The direction of the new Textevo. Based on : auto adapt the delay When you change the "Based on" mode, adjusts the delay to the new number of letters, words or lines.

docs.title: Fx
docs.text: Elastic / bounce on eased keys What to do with the keyframes eased on arrival when an Elastic or a Bounce is set: Ask, Keep the keys, Linear arrival or Optimized keys. See Eased keyframes.

docs.title: Presets folder
docs.text:
Where Textevo saves its settings and presets. Open shows the folder, Change... chooses another one.

Note

Changing the folder doesn't move your presets: copy the presets folder to the new place if you want to keep them.

docs.title: About
docs.text: The version of Textevo, and a link to this documentation.

docs.title: 2026.0.0 (beta) - September 2026
docs.text:
New

  • Fx button: Elastic, Bounce or Oscillation on the strength, with their own controls. Textevo can optimize the keyframes eased on arrival.
  • Presets applied from the start of the text layer, or at the current time with Alt + click.
  • Presets applied on all the selected text layers, or on a new text layer when none is selected.
  • Presets window: search field and rename button, presets sorted by name.
  • Presets keep what you add to the text animator (wiggly selector, fill color...) and can save the other effects of the layer (drop shadow, glow...).
  • The presets saved with an older version are updated (a copy of the originals is kept).
  • Alt + click on Paste: at the current time.
  • Alt + click on Add: reversed keyframes with mirrored easing.
  • New settings window.
  • Dialogs in the After Effects colors.

Fixes

  • Presets landing far after the text layer, or outside of the composition.
  • Paste: the keyframes now follow the start of the target layer.
  • Copy, Based on, 2D / 3D and Remove on layers with the same name, or on a Textevo renamed by hand.
  • 2D / 3D keeps the "Based on" mode.
  • The default direction of the settings is applied by Add.
  • The first launch works when the folder choice is cancelled.
  • No more changes left out of the undo history.
  • Many smaller fixes.

docs.title: 2.0.0 - January 2020
docs.text:
Major new version:

  • A light and flexible interface.
  • An effect grouping the main parameters.
  • Stack as many Textevo as you want on a layer.
  • More animation directions (random, outward, inward...).
  • A preset system.

docs.title: 1.0 - October 2015
docs.text: First release.
